repairsAndCheckScope: Browser caught a literal subset notation interpreted as JSX identifiers and a raw less-than after a copy-format pass. Replaced with explicit text, then required parse, normalized AST conservation and zero transform warnings.

Actual SVG bounds caught lower axis-label clipping; increased viewBox heights. A later opened phone image showed Reading nearly touching its bar; moved only the label and verified a visible geometric gap.
Phone measurement caught long equations. Split the mean, covariance, stratified variance and assignment formulas into meaningful lines; all nine fit 760/350/280 pixels.

Added explicit underflow rejection when a nonconstant finite law would be reported with zero variance, or a positive grouped variance/squared bias would vanish. Four rejection regressions and two small accepted controls pass; no arbitrary-precision guarantee is made.
Final copy clarifies rounded readouts and gives a concrete equal-within-pair student-weighted capstone protocol, checked by 27 independent heterogeneous eight-allocation enumerations.

Final phone help explains horizontal outcome-table navigation and actual keyboard scrolling is verified. The initial focused script used the wrong aria-label wording; corrected its locator without changing the lesson label.
research: Design ledger gives primary pages, exact selected sections/transcript pages and failed retrievals. Official MIT player links are verified; no full-video viewing or invented YouTube ID.
limitations: No empirical human/animal/device experiment or beginner usability study. All populations, potential outcomes and readings are declared teaching fixtures.
Floating-point display models have bounded educational inputs and rounded readouts; mathematical identities are derived separately. Finite checks do not prove every real-valued implementation state.

The full 149-state/width browser run precedes final copy/label/help additions. The final actual-font three-width reading pass verifies those amendments, equations, references, zero state and table keyboard access.
No publication build, global route integration, wider-goal completion or user acceptance is claimed by this author packet.
